in_sanskrit.name: Subhrajit
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who conquers or rules over auspiciousness or good fortune
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Subha - Auspicious or good fortune Rajit - Conqueror or ruler

in_hindi.name: सुभराजित
in_hindi.long_meaning: Subha - शुभकारी (auspicious, good fortune) Rajit - विजयी (conqueror, ruler)

in_tamil.name: சுப்பராஜித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Subha - பெரிய வாழ்க்கையில் (in a large fortune) Rajit - விடுதலைப் (conqueror)

in_telugu.name: శుబ్రాజిట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Subha - శుభాదిపోయిన (one who has good fortune) Rajit - జీప్ (conqueror)

in_marathi.name: Subhrajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Good Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhrajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Subhrajit is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘subh’ which means auspicious and ‘raja’ which means king. It is a name that symbolizes royalty, happiness, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Subhrajit is the name of the commander of the army of Lord Krishna.
